scientific_integrity: All-parameter statements have a symbolic lattice proof; checks through size six are finite corroboration, and exact vertex enumeration only covers sizes three and four. No independent validation has been performed.
scientific_limitations: The claim concerns normal-fan toric affine charts at torus-fixed points; it does not classify nonfixed singular strata. Katz vertex classification and earlier even-parity Gorenstein context are prior work. Full text of Katz (1970) was unavailable; potential equivalent older local classification remains a residual originality risk.
title: Local divisor class groups and canonical parity for symmetric-stochastic toric varieties
